placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Blaise Castle Estate combines a playground visit with room for a longer day outside. Separate areas for younger and older children help families choose equipment that suits their group.

Our family idea: begin with a play session, share a snack on the grass and decide whether everyone wants a short woodland walk. You can enjoy the play park without committing to an estate-wide adventure.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Mixed-age families who want play equipment and open space.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Play areas, cafe, toilets with baby changing and picnic areas.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Use the main estate car park off Kings Weston Road and check its tariff and closing time.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Stay close to children on the equipment. A visit to the museum or castle depends on separate opening arrangements.
